Outside the workshop, a group of reindeer were gathered outside, playing a fun game of tag in the freshly fallen snow. All the reindeers pranced around, having a good time. All, except one.*

*In the corner of a nearby barn, Rudolph sat alone, his bright red nose illuminating the space. His eyes were red and puffy, and his sniffles echoed in the quiet barn.
